rules.completion_rule: Every Git-committed source must achieve identical full-document semantic editorial review (all text/image, provenance, author authority, later corrections, exact SHA/anchors, all applicable domain graphs and reverse links, CI). A prior fine-grained reference, source-role card, audit finding or graph edge does not count as a completed source.
rules.source_integrity: Original fiction and user raw sources must remain byte-for-byte unchanged without express permission.
rules.branch: Non-Canon non-destructive changes direct main by author rule; risky multi-file migration use atomic Git tree or reviewed PR
rules.audit_batch_growth: 新增審核批次時在 audited_batch_paths 登記，工作板累積數依實際資料核對；五檔與封存原SHA保持嚴格不變，不能把舊批次固定數字設成未來上限。
rules.live_new_source_intake: Read HEAD Git tree using 全量來源_動態納管與驗收.mjs. All new sources, modified evidence, multimedia assets automatically join the pending universe on next actual run; not background monitoring; never silently exclude future files.
rules.goal_not_fixed_335: 335 historical baseline, total grows; 164/171 historic provenance, not mutually exclusive completion levels. Report accepted_all/total and remaining_all first.
rules.batch_full_semantic_v2: Use workload/risk-based batch planning; newly attested files require semantic_quality_v2. Existing six v1 proofs kept at historical provenance level, not automatically upgraded. CI checks section materiality and cross-batch reverse dependencies; no semantic omniscience claim.
rules.handoff_knowledge_base: Every assistant MUST read AI接手_經驗回寫與Git交易規範.md and append an issue/solution entry to AI接手_經驗更新日誌.jsonl after updating latest batch progress; CI validates journal against workboard.
rules.shard_overlay: Legacy 1.8MB ledger / 2.45MB bridge are read-only baselines; append small verified Git blob shards in AI接手_增量分片清單.json, with scripts using AI接手_分片讀取.mjs. Never overwrite legacy in routine batches.
rules.post_full_coverage_goal: 當有效來源待審為0且最新全庫主CI成功，下一主要交付應為NEXT-011高風險語義QA而非虛構新BATCH；當新檔、SHA更新、刪除/遷移或依賴失效，先處理NEXT-009/NEXT-010並讓受影響驗收重驗，保留歷史CI。
